items.title: U.S. military destroys 5 Iranian oil tankers. And, the Smithsonian head resigns
items.summary: The U.S. military says it has destroyed five Iranian oil tankers as the conflict continues to escalate. And, Smithsonian head Lonnie G. Bunch III says he plans to step down by the end of the year.
